a.xlink:title: An Op that operates on primitive types and can build optimized operations.
Base class for GP_ op codes.
Base class for IP_ (in-place assign) op codes.
Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
GP_ADD rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T + T -> T.
GP_AND rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T & T -> T.
GP_COMPL rvalue, lvalue ; ~T -> T.
GP_DIV rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T / T -> T.
GP_MOD rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T % T -> T.
GP_MUL rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T * T -> T.
GP_NEG rvalue, lvalue ; -T -> T.
GP_OR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T | T -> T.
GP_SHL rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T << T -> T.
GP_SHR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >> T -> T.
GP_USHR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >>> T -> T.
GP_SUB rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T - T -> T.
GP_XOR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T ^ T -> T.
The base class for OP_GP_RANGE% ops.
GP_ERANGEE rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >..< T -> Range<T>.
GP_ERANGEI rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >.
GP_IRANGEE rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T ..< T -> Range<T>.
GP_IRANGEI rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T .
IP_ADD rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T += T.
IP_AND rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T &= T.
IP_DIV rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T /= T.
IP_MOD rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T %= T.
IP_MUL rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T *= T.
IP_OR rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T |= T.
IP_SHL rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T <<= T.
IP_SHR rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T >>= T.
IP_USHR rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T >>>= T.
IP_SUB rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T -= T.
IP_XOR rvalue-target, rvalue2 ; T ^= T.
Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
IIP_DEC rvalue-target, rvalue-ix ; –T[ix] (no result).
IIP_INC rvalue-target, rvalue-ix ; ++T[ix] (no result).
IIP_DECA rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T[ix]– -> T.
IIP_INCA rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T[ix]++ -> T.
IIP_DECB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; –T[ix] -> T.
IIP_INCB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; ++T[ix] -> T.
I_GET rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T = T[ix].
I_SET rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue ; T[ix] = T.
IIP_ADD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] += T.
IIP_AND rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] &= T.
IIP_DIV rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_MOD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] %= T.
IIP_MUL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_OR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] |= T.
